extension.summary: Reports playback and who watched it to CrossWatch.
extension.description: Sends Kodi playback events to CrossWatch, including which household member watched, resolved from smart playlist membership, the active Kodi profile, or a prompt at the end of playback.
extension.news: v1.0.0~beta1 (2026-10-07) - Reports what you watch in Kodi to your own CrossWatch, including who in the household watched it. - Works out who watched using smart playlists, your Kodi profile, or a question at the end of playback that is remembered per show. - Pair with CrossWatch using an address and a one-time code, or link it from CrossWatch with a confirmation on the TV. No restart needed. - Settings to manage viewers, their playlists or profiles, and remembered answers. - Keeps a finished watch safe through an outage or restart, and sends it once CrossWatch is back. - Supports connecting to CrossWatch over HTTPS.
